subject: design/plangate-slice-coverage
statement: a feature-coverage check computes the **union** of the coverage matrices of all the feature's plans (`docs/plans/<feature>/*-plan.md`) and reports every live **Must** FR/UB of the governing PRD that no plan's matrix claims as a named **feature-level** coverage defect. This is where "no Must silently dropped" is enforced — at the feature, over the union — so completeness survives being split across an amendment's plans. Whether this check is a dedicated `coverage` verb, a mode of `fold`, or a project-time guard is an implementation choice (§7 Q1); what binds is that it is **feature-scoped and never a single plan's fold block** (DINV-3).
